html:
Where crypto buzz begins and your project goes viral.

If you're trying to build real momentum in the Web3 space, Crypto Twitter is the front line. It's not just a platform, it's the heartbeat of the industry. From token launches to NFT drops and DeFi alpha threads, the conversation always starts here. And if you want in, you need the right voices behind you.

We help brands and blockchain projects connect with influential creators and opinion leaders on Twitter - the people whose tweets actually move wallets, build hype, and start trends. With the right message, posted by the right person, your project can go from unnoticed to unmissable overnight.

Why Twitter Influencers Still Dominate in Web3

Crypto Twitter is where everything happens first.

Before the press covers it, before the VCs jump in, and long before mainstream attention hits - CT sees it all.

People don’t just scroll here. They speculate. They invest. They share. That’s why working with carefully selected influencers can lead to real-world results: wallet signups, Discord growth, NFT mints, token traction, not just vanity likes.

And unlike traditional ads, Twitter influencers already have built-in credibility. Their followers trust what they say. That kind of trust doesn’t come easy but when you plug into it, your brand gets real traction fast.

What We Offer With Our Twitter Influencer Campaigns

Strategic Creator Partnerships

We work with voices that actually understand your niche whether it’s NFTs, DeFi protocols, Layer 2s, or DAO tooling. From meme lords to market analysts, we’ll pair your project with influencers who feel native to your community.

Thread-Style Deep Dives

CT users love value-packed threads. We help influencers craft threads that break down your platform, roadmap, or tokenomics in a way that feels natural and genuinely insightful.

Targeted Buzz for Launches and Announcements

Planning a presale? Just listed on a new DEX? Or rolling out a staking feature? We create real-time Twitter momentum not just posts, but conversations.

CT-Friendly Messaging and Visuals

Every tweet is optimized for what CT loves: sharp phrasing, web3 tone, no fluff, no filters. We also ensure visuals match the culture whether it's memes, carousels, or graphics with real alpha appeal.

Results That Go Beyond Vanity Metrics

You’ll notice the difference almost immediately:

  • Spike in organic mentions and reposts
  • Visible bump in Twitter profile traffic
  • Growth in Telegram, Discord, or whitelist signups
  • Reactions from other creators, investors, and early adopters
  • Direct conversions to testnets, mints, or purchases

We’ve powered hundreds of campaigns for crypto projects at every stage from stealth-mode startups to post-TGE giants. And our goal isn’t just reach. It’s relevance.

How Our Process Works for Crypto Twitter Influencers

Everything’s built around your goals. You’ll get:

  • A handpicked list of influencers to review
  • Optional scripting or creative input for threads
  • Transparent tracking of posts, reach, and engagement
  • Timeline built around your launch calendar

If you’re serious about visibility in crypto, you can’t ignore Twitter.

Let’s help your brand land in the right feeds and stay there.Talk to us today or send in your campaign brief.

FAQs

1. Can I choose which influencers post about us?

Yes. We’ll recommend profiles based on your project type and target audience. Final selections are always up to you.

2. How fast can we go live?

Once creatives are locked, campaigns typically launch within 3–4 working days.

3. Do these influencers use fake followers?

Nope. We audit engagement, replies, follower quality, and past content. Every partner is manually vetted.

Boost Crypto Trust & Visibility With YouTube Influencers

Get your project in front of millions through YouTube influencers who break down complex ideas, build community trust, and drive investor action.

At MediaX, we help Web3 brands connect with top-performing crypto YouTubers who bring authentic attention and results.

Why Crypto Projects Rely on YouTube Influencers

YouTube is not just for tutorials or entertainment, it’s where deep crypto research happens. From project breakdowns to token reviews, the platform is trusted by retail investors, traders, and analysts who want more than just a tweet or a blog.

When a respected YouTuber reviews your token, dApp, or NFT collection, it adds a layer of credibility that paid ads simply can’t buy.

YouTube videos stay searchable, evergreen, and impactful long after they’re posted. Unlike short-lived tweets, a single influencer video can generate months of organic reach and steady conversions, especially when the content is optimized for keywords like your project name, ecosystem, and niche.

What Our Crypto YouTube Influencer Services Include

Project Reviews & Sponsored Videos

Influencers create honest, engaging content that covers your token utility, roadmap, whitepaper highlights, and USPs. Ideal for new launches, token revamps, or fundraising.

Tutorials & Use Case Walkthroughs

Perfect for DeFi platforms or dApps. Let creators walk users through onboarding, staking, bridging, or any feature that needs explanation.

Crypto Market Analysts

We partner with data-driven influencers who are trusted for serious reviews and portfolio strategies. These creators bring credibility for long-term investors.

NFT Showcase & GameFi Creators

For Web3 games and NFT launches, we work with lifestyle and gaming influencers who understand hype cycles and audience expectations.

Multi-Channel Campaigns

Combine YouTube with Twitter, Telegram, or Instagram influencers to drive cross-platform buzz and get more value from each campaign.

Results After Using YouTube Influencer for Crypto Marketing

  • Higher investor trust and retention from long-form video content
  • Consistent traffic and YouTube search discovery for your project name
  • Better conversion on token sales, NFT mints, or app signups
  • Increased organic sharing and embeds across crypto media
  • Improved SEO and backlinks through embedded videos on blogs/forums

We’ve helped launch and scale 100+ Web3 brands by pairing them with crypto influencers whose videos regularly rack up thousands of views and drive on-chain results.

How Our Approach Stands Out

We don’t take shortcuts with influencer marketing. Every creator we partner with is vetted not just for views, but for relevance, retention rate, and audience quality. We customize scripts, collaborate on edits, and ensure content aligns with both your messaging and YouTube’s algorithm.

You’ll get full transparency, creator lists before launch, timelines, and detailed reports on impressions, views, average watch time, CTRs, and comments.

Frequently Asked Questions about YouTube Influencers for Crypto

Q1: Can I see influencer options before the campaign starts?

Absolutely. We provide a handpicked list of creators based on your budget, blockchain vertical, and marketing goals.

Q2: Are these creators experienced in crypto content?

Yes. All influencers we work with have a history of covering tokens, dApps, NFT launches, or DeFi protocols. No generic tech YouTubers.

Q3: What’s the typical turnaround time?

Most campaigns go live within 5–7 business days once scripts and timelines are approved.
